line: It reads the warmth of your own skin and becomes your exact shade, right there on your face. No shade to pick. No wrong match. It adapts as it goes on.
motionPlan: From this frame: one continuous macro of her bare cheek: the balm's flat crest lays a white stripe, then the brush end sweeps through it in slow circles — ahead of the crown it is still white, behind it it is her own shade — until the cheek is one even tone, every line still there — slow circles, about 10 s, never cut; handheld macro, still.
